criteria.notes: Product spotlight: collection eyebrow, product name, description, price, product code, availability chip and progress through the collection.
Editorial catalogue concept retained: pale paper field, serif product name, hairline rules, single hero product photograph.
Reads as a printed catalogue page rather than an e-commerce card grid; one product occupies the surface.
Product name and price are the dominant elements and clear the room-distance floors on every surface.
Paper and ink palette holds contrast on all surfaces; the availability chip stays distinguishable against the field.
Long-copy scenario wraps the product name to three lines and keeps the description complete without ellipsis.
Image and detail column divide the surface at every aspect; the empty state substitutes a centred collection message.
Product photography renders with an intentional fit; the missing-image scenario shows a deliberate placeholder outline rather than a gap.
Pale editorial catalogue styling is distinct from the dark dashboard and transit examples.
